registry_snapshot.description: Dry-up reclaim bar: low-volume bars then reclaim of prior close with lower wick
registry_snapshot.human_readable_definition: 2+ dry-up days in the pre-window AND at least 1 reclaim bar (low dips below previous close but price closes back above it). Suggests accumulation absorption — smart money quietly buying while the stock drifts down on light volume.
registry_snapshot.notes: Seed pattern. Run discovery against run 98 to populate stats.

registry_snapshot.description: EMA50 spring reclaim: low dips below EMA50 then close recovers above, with prior dry-up
registry_snapshot.human_readable_definition: Price tests below EMA50 intraday but closes back above it (spring test), AND had 2+ dry-up days before that bar. Classic Wyckoff spring through a moving average.

registry_snapshot.description: Repeated accumulation-like days with dry-up background
registry_snapshot.human_readable_definition: At least 3 accumulation-like days (high lower wick, close mid-high on below-avg volume) AND 3+ dry-up days in the pre-window. Multi-day evidence of smart money absorption.

registry_snapshot.description: Gap-down shakeout reclaim: price shook out below support then recovered
registry_snapshot.human_readable_definition: Episode had a spring test / LPS event (low breaks support, close recovers) AND at least 1 reclaim bar. Classic shakeout before breakout pattern.
registry_snapshot.notes: Seed pattern. Based on Wyckoff spring/LPS concept.

registry_snapshot.description: Gap-up hold after dry-up: volume expansion after quiet accumulation
registry_snapshot.human_readable_definition: 3+ dry-up days AND 1+ abnormal volume days in the pre-window. Quiet accumulation period followed by a volume surge.

registry_snapshot.description: EMA cluster reclaim with extended bull stack
registry_snapshot.human_readable_definition: 2+ EMA50 reclaim events in the pre-window AND 3+ consecutive bull-stack days. Price repeatedly reclaiming and holding above the EMA50 with bullish EMA ordering.
4+ D-confluence days in the pre-window, D-confluence flag True, AND max structure score >= 55. Multiple D/WLNBB confluence signals with structural quality — indicates setup building.
registry_snapshot.notes: Seed pattern. Intended as BUY_SUPPORT only after replay validation and Scanner V2 review.

registry_snapshot.description: Dry-up then volume expansion: 5+ dry-up days followed by abnormal volume
registry_snapshot.human_readable_definition: 5+ dry-up days (volume < 60% of 20d avg) followed by at least 1 abnormal volume day (volume > 2× 20d avg). Classic 'quiet then loud' accumulation-to-ignition sequence.
registry_snapshot.notes: Seed pattern. High priority for replay validation.

registry_snapshot.description: Extended compression: 8+ compression days before breakout
registry_snapshot.human_readable_definition: 8+ BB squeeze / ATR contraction days in the pre-window, AND had_compression=True. Extended tightening of price range before the explosive move.

registry_snapshot.description: Recent reverse split speculative regime with accumulation evidence
registry_snapshot.human_readable_definition: Reverse split within 15 days of breakout (not artifact) AND 3+ dry-up days. This forms a separate speculative regime — do NOT mix with clean 4× pump model.
registry_snapshot.notes: IMPORTANT: Keep this as RESEARCH_ONLY. Reverse split regime requires its own model — do not use for Scanner V2 BUY routing. For Pump Watch: HIGH expansion risk is only a regime marker here, not an automatic reject.

registry_snapshot.description: Repeated buy pressure: 6+ BUY_CANDIDATE days in pre-window
registry_snapshot.human_readable_definition: Scanner V2 issued BUY_CANDIDATE on 6+ different days in the 40-day pre-window. This is a critical separator per raw-pattern run 98 (4× pump median ≈ 6 vs false_positive median ≈ 1). High repeated scanner agreement = strong accumulation signal.
registry_snapshot.notes: Based on key finding from run 98: buy_candidate_day_count_pre separates 4× pumps from false positives more than almost any other feature. Median 4× pump = 6 days, false_positive = 1 day.

registry_snapshot.description: Max structure spike: high structure score with confirmed/triggered phase
registry_snapshot.human_readable_definition: max_structure_score >= 70 AND (had_confirmed_structure OR had_triggered_structure). Strong scanner agreement that the stock had genuine structural setup before the pump.
registry_snapshot.notes: Seed pattern. Quality structure at pre-breakout is a known prerequisite for clean 4× pumps.

registry_snapshot.description: Full convergence: buy pressure + structure + dry-up + compression
registry_snapshot.human_readable_definition: 4+ BUY_CANDIDATE days AND max structure score >= 58 AND 5+ dry-up days AND had_compression=True. All four key signals converging at once. Highest-confidence pre-pump composite.
registry_snapshot.notes: Composite pattern requiring all four signal families simultaneously. High precision expected, lower recall.

registry_snapshot.description: Avoid-then-pump: scanner issued AVOID but stock pumped 4× with accumulation evidence
registry_snapshot.human_readable_definition: Scanner routed AVOID (had_np_avoid_pre=True) AND (had_d_confluence_pre OR had_accumulation_like). Cases where the safety router correctly blocked BUY but there was underlying accumulation activity.
registry_snapshot.notes: RESEARCH_ONLY. Based on run 98 finding: many missed 4× pumps had had_np_avoid_pre=True. This does NOT mean AVOID routing is wrong — it is correct for trade safety. But for speculative pump discovery, this pattern is worth studying. Do NOT use to weaken Scanner V2 AVOID logic.

notes.analysis_guidance: discovered_patterns contains ALL patterns including REJECTs. accepted_patterns: EXPERIMENTAL / EXPERIMENTAL_RARE / RESEARCH_ONLY. rejected_patterns: REJECT status, see reject_reason field. reliability_score = lift_vs_false_positive * sqrt(count_all_4x). split_contamination.patterns must NOT be added to scanner without first excluding split-artifact episodes from the training set. IMPORTANT: Do NOT use any pattern to modify Scanner V2 BUY/WATCH/AVOID routing. All patterns are EXPERIMENTAL or RESEARCH_ONLY only.

reject_reason_legend.no_4x_hits: Pattern matched 0 episodes in the 4x pump group
reject_reason_legend.low_count: Pattern matched < 2 episodes in the 4x pump group

source_type_legend.EPISODE_AGGREGATE: V1A: pre-window aggregate features per episode (buy_candidate_day_count_pre, etc.)

status_legend.EXPERIMENTAL: count_all_4x >= 8, lift >= 1.5 — ready for Pump Watch evaluation
status_legend.EXPERIMENTAL_RARE: count_all_4x >= 4, lift >= 2.0 — promising but needs more data
